class M(type):
 def __instancecheck__(cls,obj):
  print("check",cls.__name__)
  return False
class A(metaclass=M): pass
class B(A): pass
print(isinstance(B(),A))

class M(type):
 def __instancecheck__(cls,obj): return obj==7
class N(M): pass
class A(metaclass=N): pass
print(isinstance(7,A),isinstance(8,A))

class Checker:
 def __instancecheck__(self,obj): return obj==7
c=Checker()
c.__instancecheck__=None
print(isinstance(7,c),isinstance(8,c))

class M(type):
 def __instancecheck__(cls,obj): return [7]
class A(metaclass=M): pass
print(A.__instancecheck__(None)[0])

def check(cls,obj): return obj==7
M=type("M",(type,),{"__instancecheck__":check})
A=M("A",(),{})
print(isinstance(7,A))

def later(cls,obj): return False
class M(type):
 def __instancecheck__(cls,obj):
  M.__instancecheck__=later
  return True
class A(metaclass=M): pass
print(isinstance(7,A),isinstance(7,A))

class M(type):
 def __instancecheck__(cls,obj): return True
class A(metaclass=M): pass
print(isinstance(7,A),type(7) is int)
